description: This file implements packing and unpacking functions for PSUP PDU session information, including encoding/decoding of various fields such as PDU type, QoS flow ID, and optional timestamp and sequence number, following 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: psup_packing
classes.description: Class providing methods to pack and unpack PSUP PDU session information.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Decodes a byte buffer into a psup_dl_pdu_session_information structure, extracting fields based on bit positions and optional values.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Encodes a psup_dl_pdu_session_information structure into a byte buffer, adding necessary padding to align length.
